content: Melvin-Koushki's note to the A.1 timeline: events in Ibn Turka's life are unitalicized and other events italic; because information on his life is sparse, some dates and events are conjectured or approximate; most rest on the colophons of MS Majlis 10196, the Munshaʾāt-i Turka and the Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī; select political events come from Manz, Power, Politics and Religion. The timeline does not say entry by entry which source a date rests on.
